caption: The drawing depicts a section of patterned wallpaper, featuring a repeated design with human figures, flowers, and a bird. The background is off-white or light beige. Two human figures are present: both are dressed in green garments and have pinkish skin tones. The upper left figure is standing with one arm raised, holding a bow and arrow, surrounded by swirling, leafy floral patterns in shades of pink, red, and green, and has a beard. The lower right figure is shown wearing a wide-brimmed hat and facing forward with one hand extended, also surrounded by similar floral motifs. To the upper right, a large bird with elongated tail feathers, drawn in shades of pink and red, appears amidst the flowers. Throughout the composition, there are large, stylized flowers in rich pinks and reds with green leaves and some swirling elements in yellow and brown, filling the space evenly. The edges of the patterned section are worn and jagged, indicating damage or age, and the overall style suggests a decorative, ornamental purpose.
title: Wall Paper
